title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Charterhouse (Sydney, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Data Analyst needed for 6 month contract (possibility of renewal) with sought after NSW Government agency. Ideal candidates will have strong background in Data Analytics, with solid skills in SQL Server & Informatica. Should also have a keen interest in open source technologies such as Hadoop, Python, R, Spark etc... Convenient location close to public transport. Requirements: Relevant tertiary qualification in IT / Computer Science / Mathematics or similar... Should have 5+ years' experience in data analysis focused roles Technical Skills Informatica / ETL SQL Server / T-SQL SSIS / SSAS / SSRS Hadoop Spark R / Python
